name: java
description: trailbeam-aws-sdk-v2 (Java): the global ExecutionInterceptor on the AWS SDK for Java v2 sync client, with no code. Build first: mvn -f java/pom.xml install && mvn -f conformance/drivers/java/pom.xml package. The agent variants need OTEL_JAVA_AGENT_JAR (2.34.0) and DD_JAVA_AGENT_JAR (1.69.1).

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: the jar on the classpath, no agent, no code

variants.name: otel-agent
variants.about: beside the OpenTelemetry Java agent. parent is 'any' for now: the agent makes no span for a ReceiveMessage without an active span (a poll loop), so those receives are roots; a parent mode for that is QV-319 stage 5

variants.name: otel-agent-sampled-0
variants.about: as otel-agent, with the agent's sampler at 0%: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span

variants.name: dd-agent
variants.about: beside dd-java-agent (no Datadog agent running: its spans go nowhere, Trailbeam's still reach the Collector)
